# 好似 … · *hou2 ci5 …*

**Meaning:** seems; looks like; to be like · **Level:** B1 · **Topic:** Degree and comparison

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fhou2-ci5-seem).

好似 means 'seems' before a description, or 'to be like' before a noun: 佢好似唔開心 (she seems unhappy), 你好似你爸爸 (you look like your dad).

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢好似唔開心。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 hou2 ci5 m4 hoi1 sam1. |
| Yale | kéuih hóu chíh m̀h hōi sām. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄘㄧ⁵ ㆬ⁴ ㄏㄛㄧ¹ ㄙㄜㆬ¹. |
| English | She seems unhappy. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你好似你爸爸。** |
| Jyutping | nei5 hou2 ci5 nei5 baa4 baa1. |
| Yale | néih hóu chíh néih bàh bā. |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄘㄧ⁵ ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄅㄚ⁴ ㄅㄚ¹. |
| English | You look like your dad. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **好似要落雨喇。** |
| Jyutping | hou2 ci5 jiu3 lok6 jyu5 laa3. |
| Yale | hóu chíh yiu lohk yúh la. |
| Bopomofo | ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄘㄧ⁵ ㄧㄨ³ ㄌㄛㆶ⁶ ㄩ⁵ ㄌㄚ³. |
| English | It looks like it's going to rain. |
